Subject: Rooming and logistics for Nov 12-14 Executive Workshop

Hi team,

We are finalizing logistics for the Nov 12-14 executive workshop in San Diego. A few asks from procurement and our travel desk so we can confirm the room block and billing: 

- Can Redwood confirm how many single vs double rooms you need (we currently see ~30 attendees)?
- Do you want the group bill (Acme pays and charges back) or do you prefer participants to charge incidentals individually?
- Arrival/departure pattern: any VIPs arriving early (Nov 11) or leaving late (Nov 15)?
- Dietary / accessibility notes to share with catering.

Attached is a draft rooming spreadsheet from Acme Travel. Please review and send back a proposed rooming list by EOD Friday so the hotel can hold inventory.

Thanks,
Jane
--
Jane Sandoval
Program Manager, Events
Acme Financial
[Attachment: Acme_Exec_Rooming_Draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Subject: Re: Rooming and logistics for Nov 12-14 Executive Workshop

Jane —

Thanks for the draft. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Headcount: 30 rooms requested (26 singles, 4 doubles for shared execs).
- Billing: Redwood will provide a corporate card for the master folio; incidentals to be billed to guests. Please send the hotel the corporate authorization form (we've CC'd the hotel contact).
- VIPs: CEO (R. Malhotra) and VP Product (Laura) will arrive evening Nov 11; CTO (Marissa) might arrive late on Nov 12.
- Dietary: a few vegetarian + one severe nut allergy (details in the attached spreadsheet).

Maya — can you place a temporary hold for 30 rooms under "Redwood Inference — Acme Executive Workshop" with a cut-off of Oct 28 and confirm early check-in availability for the VIPs? Also confirm whether complimentary airport shuttle is included for early arrivals.

I've updated the rooming spreadsheet with names and arrival/departure windows.

- Attachment: RI_room_hold_request_v1.xlsx (updated rooming + notes)

Connor O'Brien
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya@grandharborhotel.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rooming and logistics for Nov 12-14 Executive Workshop

Hi Connor and Jane,

Thanks — we can hold 30 rooms under the block name you provided. Details and requests below: 

- Block: 30 rooms (26 single / 4 double) 
- Rate: $289/night (plus taxes) — corporate rate applied
- Cut-off date: Oct 28 (after this date rooms will be released)
- Early check-in: subject to availability; we will prioritize the two VIPs (CEO, Laura).
- Airport shuttle: complimentary shuttle hourly between 6am–10pm; earlier/later transfers can be arranged at a discounted rate.
- We require a signed credit card authorization form to guarantee the master folio. Please complete and return by Oct 21.

I've attached our credit authorization form and included a link to our group portal where you can upload the final rooming list. If you confirm by end of week I will convert the hold to a guaranteed block.

Attachments: Credit_Authorization_Form.pdf
Group portal: https://grandharborhotel.com/group/booking/RI-Acme-Exec

Best,
Maya Singh
Senior Account Executive
Grand Harbor Hotel
